title: Build vs Buy Software in 2026: When AI-Built Custom Tools Beat SaaS
summary: The average team uses 30% of their SaaS features but pays 100% of the cost. In 2026, AI builders change the math. Here's the decision framework.
body_markdown: According to Retool's 2026 build vs buy report, the most commonly replaced categories are: project management tools, CRM point solutions, internal reporting dashboards, approval workflow tools, and client portal software. These share a pattern — narrow workflows, high per-seat costs, and low feature utilization. They're also the categories where a custom tool can cover 100% of the use case in an afternoon. You can also[replace Airtable with a custom tool](https://blink.new/blog/replace-airtable-custom-tool) built specifically for your data model.
